MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(p.invite_code), '')) AS inviteCode, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(p.owner_phone), '')) AS ownerPhone, MAX(p.group_created_at) AS groupCreatedAt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN relation.membership_status <> #{unconfirmedStatus} THEN relation.id END) AS knownMembershipCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN relation.membership_status = #{inGroupStatus} THEN relation.id END) AS inGroupCount, MAX(CASE WHEN relation.membership_status = #{inGroupStatus} AND relation.is_admin = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adminInGroup, MAX(CASE WHEN relation.membership_status = #{inGroupStatus} AND REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(relation.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ownerInGroup, MAX(p.announce_only) AS announceOnly, MAX(p.member_size) AS memberSize, MAX(CASE WHEN relation.membership_status = #{inGroupStatus} AND relation.is_admin = 1 AND relation.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} AND relation.account_state = #{normalAccountState} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS operable FROM ( SELECT baseline_group.group_jid, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( b0.baseline_group_subjects, CONCAT('$."', REPLACE(baseline_group.group_jid, '"', '\\"'), '"') ))), '')) AS baseline_subject FROM account a0 INNER JOIN account_group_baseline b0 ON b0.tenant_id = a0.tenant_id AND b0.account_id = a0.id INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE( b0.baseline_group_jids, '$[*]' COLUMNS (group_jid VARCHAR(128) PATH '$') ) baseline_group WHERE a0.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a0.account_group_id = #{accountGroupId} AND a0.deleted_at IS NULL AND baseline_group.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(baseline_group.group_jid) <> '' GROUP BY baseline_group.group_jid ) history LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.id, m.group_jid, m.membership_status, m.is_admin, a1.ws_phone, s1.login_state, s1.account_state FROM account a1 INNER JOIN account_group_membership m ON m.tenant_id = a1.tenant_id AND m.account_id = a1.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN account_state s1 ON s1.tenant_id = a1.tenant_id AND s1.account_id = a1.id WHERE a1.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a1.account_group_id = #{accountGroupId} AND a1.deleted_at IS NULL ) relation ON relation.group_jid = history.group_jid LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.group_jid = history.group_jid LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.id = p.group_link_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY history.group_jid

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, COALESCE(m.is_admin, 0) AS groupAdmin FROM account_group_membership m INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a.id = m.account_id INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND p.group_jid = m.group_jid WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.account_group_id = #{accountGroupId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.ws_phone) <> '' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.group_jid = #{groupJid} AND m.is_admin = 1 AND m.membership_status = #{inGroupStatus} AND s.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} AND s.account_state = #{normalAccountState} ORDER BY CASE WHEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(m.last_seen_at, 0) DESC, a.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, TRUE AS groupAdmin FROM account_group_membership m INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a.id = m.account_id INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND p.group_jid = m.group_jid WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.group_jid = #{groupJid} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.membership_status = #{inGroupStatus} AND m.is_admin = 1 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.id <> #{managerAccountId} AND a.protocol_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_id) <> '' AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.ws_phone) <> '' AND s.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} AND s.account_state = #{normalAccountState} AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND s.mute_status IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(m.last_seen_at, 0) DESC, a.id ASC

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, COALESCE(m.is_admin, 0) AS groupAdmin FROM account_group_membership m INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a.id = m.account_id INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.group_jid = #{groupJid} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.membership_status = #{inGroupStatus} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.id <> #{managerAccountId} AND a.protocol_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_id) <> '' AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.ws_phone) <> '' AND s.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} AND s.account_state = #{normalAccountState} AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND s.mute_status IS NULL ORDER BY a.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.update: UPDATE group_link SET deleted_at = NULL, group_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{groupName}), ''), group_name), membership_state = CASE WHEN membership_state = 3 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, sync_protocol_mask = CASE WHEN sync_protocol_mask = 0 THEN #{syncProtocolMask} WHEN sync_protocol_mask = #{syncProtocolMask} THEN sync_protocol_mask ELSE 3 END, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{groupLinkId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_link_preview ( group_link_id, group_jid, wa_subject, member_size, owner_phone, announce_only, group_created_at, avatar_url, last_preview_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{groupLinkId}, #{groupJid}, #{waSubject}, #{memberSize}, #{ownerPhone}, #{announceOnly}, #{groupCreatedAt}, #{avatarUrl}, #{lastPreviewAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_jid = VALUES(group_jid), wa_subject = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(wa_subject)), ''), wa_subject), member_size = COALESCE(VALUES(member_size), member_size), owner_phone = CASE WHEN #{ownerPhoneObserved} = TRUE THEN NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(owner_phone)), '') ELSE owner_phone END, announce_only = COALESCE(VALUES(announce_only), announce_only), group_created_at = COALESCE(VALUES(group_created_at), group_created_at), avatar_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(avatar_url)), ''), avatar_url), last_preview_at = VALUES(last_preview_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE group_link_preview SET group_jid = #{groupJid}, wa_subject = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{waSubject}), ''), wa_subject), member_size = COALESCE(#{memberSize}, member_size), owner_phone = CASE WHEN #{ownerPhoneObserved} = TRUE THEN NULLIF(TRIM(#{ownerPhone}), '') ELSE owner_phone END, announce_only = COALESCE(#{announceOnly}, announce_only), group_created_at = COALESCE(#{groupCreatedAt}, group_created_at), avatar_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{avatarUrl}), ''), avatar_url), last_preview_at = #{lastPreviewAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE group_link_id = #{groupLinkId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_group_membership ( account_id, group_link_id, group_jid, is_admin, membership_status, status_source, status_updated_at, last_exit_type, last_exited_at, joined_at, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{groupLinkId}, #{groupJid}, #{admin}, #{membershipStatus}, #{statusSource}, #{statusUpdatedAt}, #{lastExitType}, #{lastExitedAt}, #{joinedAt}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_link_id = VALUES(group_link_id), joined_at = CASE WHEN AND VALUES(membership_status) = 1 AND account_group_membership.membership_status IN (3, 4, 5) THEN VALUES(joined_at) WHEN account_group_membership.joined_at IS NULL AND VALUES(membership_status) = 1 THEN VALUES(joined_at) ELSE account_group_membership.joined_at END, is_admin = CASE WHEN THEN COALESCE(VALUES(is_admin), account_group_membership.is_admin) ELSE account_group_membership.is_admin END, last_seen_at = CASE WHEN AND VALUES(membership_status) = 1 THEN COALESCE(VALUES(last_seen_at), account_group_membership.last_seen_at) ELSE account_group_membership.last_seen_at END, membership_status = CASE WHEN THEN VALUES(membership_status) ELSE account_group_membership.membership_status END, status_source = CASE WHEN THEN VALUES(status_source) ELSE account_group_membership.status_source END, status_updated_at = GREATEST( account_group_membership.status_updated_at, VALUES(status_updated_at) ), last_exit_type = CASE WHEN VALUES(membership_status) IN (3, 4, 5) AND (account_group_membership.last_exited_at IS NULL OR VALUES(last_exited_at) >= account_group_membership.last_exited_at) THEN VALUES(last_exit_type) ELSE account_group_membership.last_exit_type END, last_exited_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(membership_status) IN (3, 4, 5) AND (account_group_membership.last_exited_at IS NULL OR VALUES(last_exited_at) >= account_group_membership.last_exited_at) THEN VALUES(last_exited_at) ELSE account_group_membership.last_exited_at END, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = GREATEST(account_group_membership.updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))
mapper.sql: ( #{statusUpdatedAt} > status_updated_at OR ( #{statusUpdatedAt} = status_updated_at AND CASE #{statusSource} WHEN 'WGP2_REMOVE' THEN 5 WHEN 'WGP2_LEAVE' THEN 5 WHEN 'WGP2_PROMOTE' THEN 4 WHEN 'WGP2_DEMOTE' THEN 4 WHEN 'WGP2_ADD' THEN 3 WHEN 'GROUP_MEMBER_QUERY' THEN 2 WHEN 'GROUP_SNAPSHOT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END > CASE status_source WHEN 'WGP2_REMOVE' THEN 5 WHEN 'WGP2_LEAVE' THEN 5 WHEN 'WGP2_PROMOTE' THEN 4 WHEN 'WGP2_DEMOTE' THEN 4 WHEN 'WGP2_ADD' THEN 3 WHEN 'GROUP_MEMBER_QUERY' THEN 2 WHEN 'GROUP_SNAPSHOT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) )
mapper.update: UPDATE account_group_membership SET group_link_id = #{groupLinkId}, joined_at = CASE WHEN AND #{membershipStatus} = 1 AND membership_status IN (3, 4, 5) THEN #{joinedAt} WHEN joined_at IS NULL AND #{membershipStatus} = 1 THEN #{joinedAt} ELSE joined_at END, is_admin = CASE WHEN THEN COALESCE(#{admin}, is_admin) ELSE is_admin END, last_seen_at = CASE WHEN AND #{membershipStatus} = 1 THEN COALESCE(#{lastSeenAt}, last_seen_at) ELSE last_seen_at END, membership_status = CASE WHEN THEN #{membershipStatus} ELSE membership_status END, status_source = CASE WHEN THEN #{statusSource} ELSE status_source END, status_updated_at = GREATEST(status_updated_at, #{statusUpdatedAt}), last_exit_type = CASE WHEN #{membershipStatus} IN (3, 4, 5) AND (last_exited_at IS NULL OR #{lastExitedAt} >= last_exited_at) THEN #{lastExitType} ELSE last_exit_type END, last_exited_at = CASE WHEN #{membershipStatus} IN (3, 4, 5) AND (last_exited_at IS NULL OR #{lastExitedAt} >= last_exited_at) THEN #{lastExitedAt} ELSE last_exited_at END, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, #{updatedAt}) WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND group_jid = #{groupJid} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, COALESCE(m.is_admin, 0) AS groupAdmin FROM account_group_membership m INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a.id = m.account_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND a.protocol_account_id != '' AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND a.ws_phone != '' INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id AND s.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} AND s.account_state = #{normalAccountState} LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND p.group_link_id = m.group_link_id WHERE m.group_link_id = #{groupLinkId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.membership_status = 1

SELECT controlled_account.id AS accountId, member.group_link_id AS groupLinkId, member.group_jid AS groupJid, MAX(member.is_admin) AS admin FROM whatsapp_group_member_snapshot member INNER JOIN account controlled_account ON controlled_account.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND controlled_account.ws_phone = member.phone AND controlled_account.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE member.group_link_id = #{groupLinkId} AND member.phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(member.phone) <> '' GROUP BY controlled_account.id, member.group_link_id, member.group_jid ORDER BY controlled_account.id ASC
